answer.explanation: Between 21:06 and 21:16 UTC the CompressionFunction was throttled on every minute (15 to 33 throttles per minute) while handling about 28 to 34 invocations per minute, with zero errors. The live configuration sets ReservedConcurrentExecutions=1, but the IaC template declares no reserved concurrency for this function, so the live value is drift from the intended state. A concurrency cap of 1 explains the throttling. The other functions' live memory, timeout, environment and roles match the template, and the only template-related commit in the history (22ac2c5, OUTPUT_BUCKET set to a missing bucket) was reverted before the window, so it does not explain the anomaly; it is listed only as a reference candidate.
